dylan (Customer): Hey team — we just hit this in prod. Streaming chat API returned a truncated JSON payload mid-stream, our parser threw and user saw a 500. request-id: r-8a7c3d2e

maria (Support): sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the raw stream payload and the request-id? also which SDK/lang?

dylan (Customer): node fetch. here's the raw SSE chunks from our proxy (redacted):

```
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\\\"reply\\\":\\\"Here is part 1\n"}

data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":" and part 2\n"}}]}

data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"\"}
```

(last chunk missing final braces). We see a socket FIN right after that. Request-id r-8a7c3d2e.

luis (Support): thanks — can you confirm you're using our streaming JSON mode (structured_output=true) and whether you set max token or stop sequence?

dylan (Customer): yes structured_output=true. no stop sequence. chunk_size default. happens intermittently ~1/2000 requests.

alex (SRE): this looks like an EOF mid-chunk. Can you share your proxy (nginx) timeout settings and whether any LB sits between you and Redwood?

dylan (Customer): Cloudflare in front, then our nginx (keepalive 30s), then our node app. Cloudflare logs show upstream closed connection 200ms earlier.

jin (Eng): @alex please check our ingress logs for r-8a7c3d2e. if possible include upstream-close reasons. Also ask customer for raw TCP dump if they can reproduce.

alex (SRE): pulled logs for r-8a7c3d2e — connection reset by peer on our side at 2025-03-12T14:22:31. Client IP shows long-lived connection then abrupt FIN. No server OOM.

maria (Support): dylan, can you try toggling streaming to non-streaming (polling full response) as a short-term mitigation? Also can you attach a HAR or tcpdump of a repro?

dylan (Customer): I'll try non-streaming. We can reproduce in staging with a script. attaching a minimal repro (curl) below:

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/streams?structured_output=true" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"long multipart payload"}],"max_tokens":1500}'
```

(succeeds sometimes, other times returns truncated event).

alex (SRE): likely causes: intermediate proxy idle timeout, Cloudflare worker limiting body size, or client closing early. Two action items: 1) customer to capture tcpdump for a repro; 2) we will instrument ingress to log chunk boundary events and upstream-close reason.

jin (Eng): also asking infra to check our chunked transfer encoder bug — rare edge case where final chunk terminator could be dropped on heavy concurrency. Putting a quick read-only check in the runtime to assert final chunk send.

maria (Support): has the customer reported any auth or billing errors alongside this? any 401/402?

dylan (Customer): no auth/billing issues — only parser errors client-side. we see 200 with truncated SSE body.

alex (SRE): update — we found correlation with connections that pass through a specific CF POP (iad2). For r-8a7c3d2e the close came from that POP. Reaching out to Cloudflare support with packet snippet.

jin (Eng): created internal tracker INF-7932 to add guard that re-sends last event terminator if EOF seen without final brace in structured mode. Will also add a visible per-request flag in logs when structured_output=true.

luis (Support): proposed interim mitigation for the customer: enable client-side tolerant parser that buffers until timeout and attempts recovery, or switch to non-streaming. We can also issue a short-run rate limit exception to route through a different POP if needed.

dylan (Customer): thanks — we'll flip to non-streaming for now and run tcpdump on repro. please keep me posted on INF-7932.

maria (Support): noted. follow-ups: - customer to upload tcpdump + HAR (if reproduction) - infra to add ingress logging for chunk boundaries - eng to patch runtime guard INF-7932 - notify customer when CF ticket updates.

deploy-bot: deploy started for patch/inf-7932 at 2025-03-12T15:05:02Z :rocket:

alex (SRE): marking this as high priority until we confirm CF root cause. will post packet gist once we have permission.

maria (Support): assigning internal owner luis to coordinate. dylan, I'll ping you when we have the next steps. :thumbsup:
